meta.command: set -euo pipefail export PATH="/cache/cargo-shared/bin:${PATH}" mkdir -p target/moon-locks target/fuzz-tsan if ! flock --shared target/moon-locks/source-mutation.lock \   rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo fuzz build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \     --sanitizer thread \     --target-dir "$PWD/target/fuzz-tsan/build" \     --build-std \   >target/fuzz-tsan/build.log 2>target/fuzz-tsan/build.err; then   cat target/fuzz-tsan/build.log   cat target/fuzz-tsan/build.err   exit 1 fi mapfile -t fuzz_targets < <(cargo fuzz list) if [ "${#fuzz_targets[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then   echo "cargo fuzz list returned no targets" >&2   exit 1 fi for tgt in "${fuzz_targets[@]}"; do   bin="target/fuzz-tsan/build/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/${tgt}"   if [ -x "$bin" ]; then     echo "TSAN-OK: $tgt"   else     echo "TSAN-MISSING: $tgt"     exit 1   fi done

set -euo pipefail mkdir -p target/kani-tmp mkdir -p target/moon-locks # Multiple --harness flags run in one cargo kani invocation: the # CBMC pipeline spins up once and the dep-graph fingerprint is # paid only once. Previous per-harness calls cost ~9m for the # validate crate; this form completes in seconds when the # fingerprint and goto binaries are warm. TMPDIR="$PWD/target/kani-tmp" flock --shared target/moon-locks/source-mutation.lock env -u RUSTC_WRAPPER CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/kani-vb-validate RUSTFLAGS="-Dwarnings" timeout 25m rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo kani -p vb_validate --all-features --quiet --harness kani_gate_08_valid_zero_accessors_pass --harness kani_gate_08_arbitrary_parts_valid_accessors_pass --harness kani_gate_08_arbitrary_parts_root_oob_rejected --harness kani_gate_08_arbitrary_parts_symbol_oob_rejected
bash scripts/check-ignored-fallible-results.sh

set -euo pipefail if ! command -v rg >/dev/null 2>&1; then   printf 'Missing required scanner: rg
' >&2   exit 127 fi mkdir -p target/static-audit unsafe_pattern='(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])unsafe[[:space:]]*(\{|fn |trait |impl |extern |\()' log_file='target/static-audit/unsafe-audit.log' if rg -n "$unsafe_pattern" crates --glob '*.rs' --glob '!**/tests/**' --glob '!**/benches/**' --glob '!**/examples/**' --glob '!**/fixtures/**' --glob '!**/verification/**' --glob '!**/kani*/**' >"$log_file"; then   cat "$log_file" >&2   printf 'Forbidden first-party unsafe construct found.
' >&2   exit 1 else   rg_status="$?"   if [ "$rg_status" -eq 1 ]; then     :   else     cat "$log_file" >&2     printf 'Unsafe audit scan failed with rg status %s.
' "$rg_status" >&2     exit "$rg_status"   fi fi

set -euo pipefail mkdir -p target/kani-tmp mkdir -p target/moon-locks # Multi-harness invocation: cargo-kani accepts multiple --harness # flags (per the cargo-kani 0.x help), so the CBMC pipeline spins # up once and the dep-graph fingerprint is paid only once. Sharing # CARGO_TARGET_DIR with the validate task keeps the CBMC side # artifacts warm across tasks. TMPDIR="$PWD/target/kani-tmp" flock --shared target/moon-locks/source-mutation.lock env -u RUSTC_WRAPPER CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/kani-vb-core RUSTFLAGS="-Dwarnings" timeout 25m rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo kani --lib -p vb_core --all-features --quiet --harness kani_budget_add_dim_zero --harness kani_budget_sub_dim_zero --harness kani_aggregate_usage_zero --harness kani_try_add_budget_zero_current

set -euo pipefail export PATH="/cache/cargo-shared/bin:${PATH}" mkdir -p target/moon-locks target/fuzz-regress if ! flock --shared target/moon-locks/source-mutation.lock env RUSTFLAGS="-Dwarnings" rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo fuzz build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --target-dir "$PWD/target/fuzz-asan/build" >target/fuzz-regress/build.log 2>target/fuzz-regress/build.err; then   cat target/fuzz-regress/build.log   cat target/fuzz-regress/build.err   exit 1 fi rc=0 while IFS= read -r artifact; do   tgt=$(basename "$(dirname "$artifact")")   bin="target/fuzz-asan/build/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/${tgt}"   if [ ! -x "$bin" ]; then     echo "MISSING: $tgt (binary required for $artifact)"     rc=1     continue   fi   echo "REPLAY: $artifact via $tgt"   if timeout 5s "$bin" "$artifact" >"target/fuzz-regress/${tgt}.log" 2>&1; then     echo "PASS: $artifact"   else     echo "REGRESSION: $artifact"     cat "target/fuzz-regress/${tgt}.log"     rc=1   fi done < <(find fuzz/artifacts -type f \( -name 'crash-*' -o -name 'oom-*' -o -name 'leak-*' -o -name 'timeout-*' \) 2>/dev/null || true) exit "$rc"
